opening_other_nwc_bridge.tax_convention: Normal period tax accrual in NOPAT; VAT/prepaid tax and historical payable balances roll in aggregate NWC once. No extra repayment of full historical tax line.
opening_other_nwc_bridge.capital_payables_convention: Keep already-accrued capital/mold payable in opening NWC; its settlement is additional to future new-asset cash capex, not a second financing-debt deduction.
opening_other_nwc_bridge.employee_convention: Remove proxy before NWC roll so normal unlock does not create cash repayment; only paired refund event pays it.
opening_other_nwc_bridge.warranty_convention: Contained in other current liabilities only; no second provision or terminal deduction.
